operations.title: 1257 — An Asymmetric Momentum-Conserving Five-Site Physical Slice Is Frozen
operations.body: A replacement physical slice uses integer resultants (1,0,0),(0,1,0),(0,0,1),(1,2,3),(-2,-3,-4), which sum to zero. The routing Gram determinant is 1, q4=(-1,-1,4) in the routing basis, Xi=t has real domain t≥sqrt29, and the Gram permutation stabilizer is trivial. No cyclic reduction is admissible.

operations.title: Benincasa freezes the corrected asymmetric physical five-site slice
operations.body: Entry 1257 freezes the replacement physical family: P1=e1,P2=e2,P3=e3,P4=(1,2,3),P5=(-2,-3,-4), so sum P=0; routing H=[[1,1,1],[1,2,2],[1,2,3]] has det1; q4=(-1,-1,4); Xi=t is physical for t≥sqrt29. Exhaustive Gram-permutation audit gives identity stabilizer. Therefore all 180 terms, 26 walls, and 32 Kummer labels must remain; next is a fresh 26-wall Landau census without cyclic inheritance.
